breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=0.9 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 0.8].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the time domain `t in [0,0.8]` and the requested output time `T=0.9`. The ground truth corrects the output time to `T=0.8` to match the domain. The agent's specification incorrectly repeated the request to compute the solution until `T = 0.9`, which is outside the specified time domain.
